scope: Local Masakari source repair and Kolla-Ansible supplement; no live cloud changes

patch_replay.method: git archive of each exact base, git apply --check, git apply, compare complete git write-tree to source HEAD tree

skip_reasons: SO_REUSEADDR behaves differently on OSX and BSD
masakari_full_unit_suite.command: python -B -c 'import masakari.tests.unit; from masakari import objects; objects.register_all(); import unittest; unittest.main(module=None)' discover -v -s masakari/tests/unit -t .
masakari_full_unit_suite.note: Initial sandbox run had 13 local socket permission errors; complete final run allowed local WSGI sockets and passed

cases: Missing/broken/duplicate fencing plugin rejects flow construction
Wrong plugin result type (empty Flow or unrelated Task) rejects construction
Misordered or incomplete PowerOps stages reject construction
Reserved-host preparation and evacuation cannot leave the retry stage
Real auto/rh TaskFlow executes disable, fence, prepare, evacuate in order
Both priority fallbacks reject broken fencing before task execution
Same Nova host with different hypervisor_hostname does not confirm evacuation
Missing/invalid destination or pending/absent task_state cannot report success
Reserved destination and final observation must match confirmation
stop_server/ownership error before timer construction is preserved
Checker validates deployed config without synthesizing missing fencing
Checker does not initialize RPC or TaskFlow persistence or connect sockets
Checker terminates its own hung process with SIGALRM

wheel.installation: Non-editable wheel in a new isolated venv; imports verified from site-packages, outside source cwd

kolla_ansible.method: Actual gate/import/serial/limit/loop/delegation/async semantics; container and deployment commands replaced with local event markers

quality_gates.independent_source_review: no open must-fix findings after re-review
quality_gates.independent_kolla_and_helpers_review: no open must-fix findings after checker timeout fix

environment.note: Frozen existing test environment, not replacement SberLinux RPM constraints. uv reported fixtures 4.2.4.post1 as yanked; dependency modernization was not in scope. Legacy pkg_resources/asyncore deprecation warnings remain.
